no LLVM, no GCC in the pipeline
every number from a sealed receipt
C-HIR interpreter and EvoIR interpreter are
runs through both, and a difference is a defect

evo-proofcheck replays it against the before and
after programs and shares no code with the optimizer
four lanes: source IR, optimized IR, machine IR,

The specification is the only authority
EvoIR spec 1.9.68 and EvoMIR spec 0.15 freeze every rule
a rule about observable behaviour is measured in a sealed
GCC-14.2 / Clang-19.1 container before it is written down
when the two disagree, the spec takes the answer that refuses
anything unspecified fails closed with a named diagnostic
a window opens with a tests-only commit whose failures
are declared in advance, and closes with a sealed receipt
an executor that meets a gap in the spec stops and reports;
it may probe the oracles, never guess
no status exists that a command did not produce

ranked, one rule per class, re-surveyed until the face changes
mixed-link lane: GCC builds the kernel, EvoCC replaces units,
kbuild relinks, QEMU boots, a failure bisects to one unit
ladder: c-testsuite, GCC torture, zlib, zstd, Mbed TLS, musl, Linux
